fastino-gliner-2-5-decide.note: Measured via Fastino's hosted API. A 340M English classifier (8k context), not built for multi-step reasoning: near chance on Noul and Score items; 23 very long items exceed its context. Our request follows Fastino's documented format. The open checkpoint scores 11.2 on the community Decision Index (rank 53 of 70; Jev 57.9). Fastino's larger GLiDE is a separate model, ranked separately on the API board.
